exec: pm.test('Admin login returns public fields and an access/refresh pair', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(Object.keys(body).sort()).to.eql(['accessToken','accountType','availablePoints','displayName','expiresIn','refreshToken','uuid']); pm.expect(body.uuid).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.accountType).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.availablePoints).to.be.a('number').and.at.least(0); pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.be.empty; pm.expect(body.refreshToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.be.empty; pm.expect(body.expiresIn).to.equal(900); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('password'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has('Set-Cookie')).to.equal(false); pm.collectionVariables.set('loginUserUuid', body.uuid); pm.collectionVariables.set('loginAccessToken', body.accessToken); pm.collectionVariables.set('loginRefresh0', body.refreshToken); const parts = body.refreshToken.split('.'); parts[2] = (parts[2][0] === 'A' ? 'B' : 'A') + parts[2].slice(1); pm.collectionVariables.set('tamperedRefresh', parts.join('.')); });

item.name: Attacker-first refresh is revoked when the user retries the old token

exec: const send = options => new Promise((resolve, reject) => pm.sendRequest(options, (error, response) => error ? reject(error) : resolve(response)));

(async () => { const baseUrl = pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}'); const login = await send({ url: baseUrl + '/auth/login', method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ loginId: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{entitledLoginId}}'), password: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{entitledPassword}}') }) } }); const oldToken = login.json().refreshToken; const rotate = token => send({ url: baseUrl + '/auth/refresh', method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ refreshToken: token }) } }); const attacker = await rotate(oldToken); pm.test('Attacker-first refresh receives the first successful rotation', () => pm.expect(attacker.code).to.equal(200)); const victimRetry = await rotate(oldToken); pm.test('Victim retry detects the replay and revokes that login', () => { pm.expect(victimRetry.code).to.equal(401); pm.expect(victimRetry.json().errorCode).to.equal('AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN'); }); const newest = await rotate(attacker.json().refreshToken); pm.test('The attacker-first response token is rejected after replay detection', () => pm.expect(newest.code).to.equal(401)); })().catch(error => pm.test('Attacker-first refresh scenario completes', () => { throw error; }));

item.name: Concurrent refresh permits one response and revokes the resulting session on replay

exec: const send = options => new Promise((resolve, reject) => pm.sendRequest(options, (error, response) => error ? reject(error) : resolve(response)));

(async () => { const login = await send({ url: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}/auth/login'), method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ loginId: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{entitledLoginId}}'), password: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{entitledPassword}}') }) } }); pm.test('Concurrency fixture login succeeds', () => pm.expect(login.code).to.equal(200)); const token = login.json().refreshToken; const request = { url: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}/auth/refresh'), method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ refreshToken: token }) } }; const pair = await Promise.all([send(request), send(request)]); const codes = pair.map(response => response.code).sort(); pm.test('Exactly one simultaneous refresh succeeds', () => pm.expect(codes).to.eql([200, 401])); const success = pair.find(response => response.code === 200).json(); const replay = await send({ url: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}/auth/refresh'), method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ refreshToken: success.refreshToken }) } }); pm.test('Successful response token is rejected after concurrent replay detection', () => { pm.expect(replay.code).to.equal(401); pm.expect(replay.json().errorCode).to.equal('AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN'); }); })().catch(error => pm.test('Concurrent refresh scenario completes', () => { throw error; }));
